definitions.PLAN_COVERAGE: The plan does not cover one or more required facts or subquestions.
definitions.PLAN_DUPLICATION: Equivalent tasks are scheduled more than once without a justified dependency.
definitions.PLAN_DEPENDENCY: A dependency is missing, cyclic, or ordered after its consumer.
definitions.RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT_MISS: No hit is returned from a required/key document.
definitions.RETRIEVAL_SECTION_MISS: The right document is hit but the key section or chunk is not retrieved.
definitions.RETRIEVAL_NOISE: Irrelevant allowed hits dominate the retrieval set.
definitions.RETRIEVAL_PERMISSION_LEAK: A hit, observation, evidence item, or citation uses a document outside the manifest allowlist.
definitions.EVIDENCE_ORIGINAL_NOT_READ: A search/Page Index observation is promoted without an original-range read.
definitions.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Verified evidence does not cover the facts required for the expected behavior.
definitions.EVIDENCE_WRONG_LOCATOR: Evidence version, hash, document, or locator does not match the frozen source.
definitions.EVIDENCE_CONFLICT_MISCLASSIFIED: Conflicting/versioned sources are ignored or ordinary evolution is incorrectly called a conflict.
definitions.REPORT_INCORRECT: The report contradicts the frozen sources or expected behavior.
definitions.REPORT_INCOMPLETE: The report omits one or more required facts or requested comparisons.
definitions.REPORT_UNFAITHFUL: A factual report statement is unsupported by verified evidence.
definitions.CITATION_MISSING: A factual claim has no citation/evidence reference.
definitions.CITATION_UNSUPPORTED: The cited evidence does not support its claim.
definitions.CITATION_BROKEN_LINK: A rendered source URL is absent when required or fails the link check.
definitions.RUNTIME_TIMEOUT: The run reaches its configured time limit.
definitions.RUNTIME_PROVIDER_FAILURE: The configured model/provider fails before a valid terminal result.
definitions.RUNTIME_FALLBACK: A fallback provider, model, search path, or answer path is used.
definitions.RUNTIME_RECOVERY_FAILURE: Checkpoint recovery is attempted but cannot resume safely.
